question:
With reference to the "Mission for Cotton Productivity" approved by the Union Cabinet in June 2026, consider the following statements:
1. It is to be jointly implemented by the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare and the Ministry of Textiles.
2. It targets raising cotton lint productivity to 755 kg per hectare by 2030-31.
3. It has a total outlay of over Rs 5,000 crore for the period 2026-27 to 2030-31.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: All three are correct: the Mission (outlay Rs 5,659.22 crore, 2026-27 to 2030-31) is implemented jointly by the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare and the Ministry of Textiles, aiming to raise lint productivity from ~440 to 755 kg/ha by 2031, aligned with the 5F (Farm-Fibre-Factory-Fashion-Foreign) vision.
subject: Agriculture

question:
Consider the following statements about the Zojila Tunnel, which achieved its breakthrough in June 2026:
1. It is being constructed on National Highway-1 between Baltal and Minamarg.
2. It will provide all-weather connectivity between the Kashmir Valley and Ladakh.
3. It is being executed by the Border Roads Organisation (BRO).
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct - the ~13.15 km tunnel on NH-1 (Baltal-Minamarg) will give year-round Srinagar-Ladakh connectivity, bypassing the snow-bound Zojila Pass. Statement 3 is wrong: it is being executed by MEIL (Megha Engineering) under NHIDCL, not the BRO.
subject: Infrastructure

question: The Prime Minister Research Chair (PMRC) Scheme 2026, recently in the news, is an initiative of which one of the following?
options: (b) Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
(d) Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
explanation: PMRC 2026 is run by the Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education. It seeks to attract Indian-origin researchers/scientists from abroad to premier Indian institutions (NIRF top-ranked) and national labs under DST/DBT/ICMR/CSIR, across 13 priority sectors such as AI, semiconductors and climate technologies.
subject: Polity & Governance
